name: @zillions/webzjs-keys
description: Vendored WebZjs keys WASM built from source with added offline address bindings (get_unified_address / from_seed_phrase). Distinct name from @chainsafe/webzjs-keys so the legacy app's npm dependency is untouched. Run `npm run build:webzjs` in apps/z-extension to (re)generate the .js/.wasm.
